name: UI：生产看板-整体推送进度4项指标验证
description: 验证总任务数/生产中/已推送/未推送4项指标展示

steps.expression: return (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const metrics = ['总任务数','生产中','已推送','未推送']; const found = metrics.filter(m => t.includes(m)); return { metrics, found, missing: metrics.filter(m => !t.includes(m)), coverage: found.length+'/'+metrics.length }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证4项指标 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-statistic, .ant-card, [class*=statistic], [class*=metric], [class*=card]')); return { cardCount: cards.length, values: cards.slice(0, 8).map(c => (c.textContent || '').trim().substring(0, 50)) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在生产数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 指标: 总任务数/生产中/已推送/未推送
